info.title: WIS WhatsApp API
info.description: Local SQLite API for one WIS connection wis-5679. Bearer tokens have explicit scopes. Admin cookies and same-origin Origin are required for administration. Sends and webhook delivery are disabled by default. Live dashboard pagination preserves data arrays and adds top-level meta. Snapshots are observed data, never a claim of complete WhatsApp history. Sync queues read-only work and does not activate outbound. Successful read audits are sampled once per actor/resource/minute and contain no query, content, credentials or QR.

get.summary: Get observed local data coverage
get.description: Returns aggregate entity counts, persisted top-level and nested snapshot paths, the count of records containing each path, the count of records whose value is non-empty text, and the latest snapshot write time for a record containing the path. It also groups read commands by kind and status with counts and latest update time, without exposing command IDs, targets, or error fields. Snapshots may merge older fields, so this is not the field value's refresh time. Array indexes are normalized as [] without rewriting quoted literal keys. Paths longer than 100 characters or beyond the first 100 names per snapshot kind are omitted and counted. Field inventory rows stream from SQLite; retained paths are capped at 10,000 per record and snapshot kind, with field_inventory_truncated indicating a cap. Query time still scales with total snapshot data scanned. It never returns message or contact values and never claims complete history.

200.description: Coverage counts, observed top-level and nested field paths with per-path record counts, non-empty text record counts, and latest snapshot write times, omitted field counts, cap indicator, message type counts, and command counts grouped by kind/status, plus allowlisted failed-read codes, without targets, command IDs or raw error text

get.summary: Read persisted blocklist; administrator cookie only
get.description: Administrator-only persisted blocklist. A failed refresh preserves earlier rows: stale marks retained information, last_success_at dates its last successful read, last_attempt_at dates the latest attempt, and error is a sanitized code. Retained rows do not prove current blocking state. GET performs no provider request or account mutation. Passive blocklist notifications invalidate the prior list without modifying identifiers. meta.collection_status=stale takes precedence over complete; stale_reason is passive_blocklist_change or change_during_read when known. last_invalidated_at records receipt time, not a successful list read. A later verified read clears stale. Missing observations never imply an empty current list.

No action is activated by reading this endpoint. Retry contract: max_attempts=5 includes the initial attempt; at most four retries are scheduled after 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds. A failed fifth attempt is terminal; its available_at value does not schedule another retry.

get.summary: Live aggregate coverage of documented WHAPI response fields
get.description: Compares unique documented response paths per operation with local snapshot and storage field availability. Returns counts and capability ids only, including routes with evidence not explicitly marked stale and routes supported only by explicitly stale evidence.
